roofShelter.status: Current v15 geometry-derived snow shelter metadata; runtime separately tested
roofShelter.coordinates: Blender meters Z-up; glTF meters Y-up via (x,y,z)->(x,z,-y).
roofShelter.method: Union of upward-facing evaluated roof triangles, preserving the current west-roof notch and redesigned porch/side-wing footprints.
roofShelter.interpretation: Proposed downward shelter columns from each actual roof triangle to the associated foundation minimum. Interpolate roof height per triangle; do not use group AABBs/convex hulls as exact masks.
limitations: Architectural dimensions remain virtual design proposals.
No added lateral safety padding; any runtime padding must be explicit.
